upgrade-motion-scope.name: Bounded, visibility-aware project sequence study
upgrade-motion-scope.api: Motion m.create(Card), named variants, LayoutGroup, useInView, usePageInView, useScopeMotion, scoped animate keyframes and one reverse repeat
upgrade-motion-scope.purpose: Custom component animation / Keyframe sequences / Parent/child orchestration / Repeat and reverse / LayoutGroup / useInView / usePageInView / useScopeMotion. Implements the accepted Add/Optional assessment with the stated content boundaries.
upgrade-motion-scope.customisation: The bounded study uses m.create(Card), the lightweight custom-component equivalent, with the Card ref forwarded. Run the signal sequence: its explicit x/opacity keyframes complete and stop. The three study steps use a bounded 40ms child stagger; Static/reduced mode shows all immediately. The user-triggered study has one reverse repeat, then stops. The form busy loop stops on completion. The study nodes share a local LayoutGroup, rather than introducing a page-wide group without need. The section’s visible/out-of-view status gates the demonstration. Switch browser tabs: nonessential study work is cancelled/paused when the document is hidden. Run the bounded sequence, then unmount it or change mode; the scope cancels work and restores styles.
